## Core Services
- [Computer Repair](https://virnobyte.com/services/computer-repair): Desktop diagnosis, motherboard repair, PSU replacement, OS reinstallation.
- [Laptop Repair](https://virnobyte.com/services/laptop-repair): Screen replacement, battery replacement, hinge repair, keyboard repair.
- [Custom PC Building](https://virnobyte.com/custom-pc-builder): 3D PC builder for gaming, video editing, and workstations.
- [CCTV Security Systems](https://virnobyte.com/services/cctv-installation): Commercial and residential IP camera setup and recording.
- [Structured Networking](https://virnobyte.com/services/networking): Wi-Fi mesh, CAT6 cabling, switch and router setups.
- [Data Recovery](https://virnobyte.com/services/data-recovery): HDD, SSD, and external drive recovery with cleanroom diagnostics.
- [IT AMC](https://virnobyte.com/services/amc-services): Annual maintenance contracts with scheduled monthly servicing and SLA.
